title: mere
gallery_text: Thermal Algorithm is an interactive installation that translates environmental data into a physical and spatial experience. The project explores how computational systems can make large-scale climatic processes perceptible through changes that can be seen, felt, and experienced.

answers.interest: I’m interested in this class because I want to understand simulation not only as a technical tool, but also as a medium for design and system thinking. My background is more in design, creative technology, and environmental studies, and I’m especially interested in how data and computational systems can become spatial, interactive, or physical experiences.
answers.suggestions: I would be especially interested in demos that connect simulation or data to physical and spatial design, such as using environmental data, or simple physical prototypes as inputs and outputs of a model. I would also be interested in tutorials that show how simulations can move beyond maps and become interactive installations, objects, or spatial experiences.
